text:
Maya: Received pen test report v1.2 — 1 high (priv esc via metadata service), 2 medium (insecure object ACLs, excessive iam perms). Need to schedule retest and finalize evidence handoff. Proposing June 22 23:00-02:00 UTC. Thoughts?
Rohit: That window works for infra. Two immediate asks: 1) How do we give assessors access to artifacts without sharing KMS keys? 2) Do we allow any live checks against production models?
Lena: For artifacts we can either 1) presigned S3 URLs + locked bucket, or 2) ephemeral role that can GetObject + kms:Decrypt limited to the evidence key. Prefer ephemeral role for auditability.
Chris: If assessors need to run crypto checks we should also allow kms:GenerateDataKey, but scoped to a test key that has no production access. Create a separate pt-evidence key in same account.
ops-bot: Note: auto-created ticket PT-3129 (readroom) assigned to @Rohit.
Maya: Good call on a separate key. Rohit, can you provision pt-evidence-key in us-west-2 and enable key policy that denies Delete for 14 days? We also want to pause rotation from 24h before window until 24h after.
Rohit: Yep. I'll provision and set rotation-suspend tag. CLI I'll run: 
```bash
aws kms create-key --description "pt-evidence-key-2026-06" --tags TagKey=pt,TagValue=true
# then schedule rotation hold via internal tooling
```
Lena: Runbook item for evidence liaison: 1) snapshot CloudTrail (all regions) 2) export proxy/auth logs 3) freeze object ACLs and apply bucket-level object-lock governance 4) upload manifest with SHA256 checksums + signer info.
Maya: Manifest format example (one-liner): 
`manifest: {"run":"pt-622","items":[{"path":"s3://redwood-pt-evidence/pt-622/app.log","sha256":"...","signed_by":"Rohit"}]}`
Chris: We should standardize the assume-role policy for assessors. Minimal example: 
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/pt-assessor-role"
    }
  ]
}
```
And the role policy: 
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence","arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"]},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/pt-evidence-key"],"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:PrincipalTag/assessor":"true"}}}
  ]
}
```
Lena: Add Condition to limit by source ip (vendor ASN ranges) and Require MFA for human sessions. Also we must log sts:AssumeRole CloudTrail events and include aws:PrincipalTag tags so we can filter.
Maya: For readroom creds: we'll create timeboxed credentials via our internal STS proxy. TTL 45m, and assessors must present signed NDA confirmation. Rohit, can you route presigned upload endpoints through presign-service so we can revoke quickly if needed?
Rohit: Yes. We'll use presign-service and short TTL uploads (2h) and set object-lock mode: GOVERNANCE with retention 90d. Will post the bucket policy once created.
security-bot: Reminder: evidence retention policy requires 90 days for third-party assessments. See policy ID GRC-17.
Chris: One gotcha: key rotation might rewrap objects if we re-encrypt during migration. Ensure we do not re-encrypt or we preserve previous key material for the objects in pt-evidence bucket. Prefer not to touch objects once uploaded.
Lena: Agreed. Also take a snapshot of KMS key metadata (key rotation status, policy) before the window and attach to manifest.
Maya: Ops note: If vendor wants to run load tests against dedicated capacity, ops will isolate a spare cluster with pinned models. We'll serve test traffic from a separate endpoint and throttle via rate limits. No direct DB writes allowed.
Rohit: Action items I have: provision key, create bucket with object-lock, enable presign-service hooks, schedule rotation hold. ETA 48h.
Lena: Action items I have: runbook template fill, audit snapshots script, manifest signer. I'll post scripts.
Chris: I'll create the pt-assessor-role and policy, include PrincipalTag enforcement + MFA condition.
Maya: Please ack when done and paste ticket IDs. I'll lock the retest window once we have all pieces.
Rohit: Ack. Ticket PT-3130 created for key/bucket provisioning.
Lena: Ack. WIP script: https://gist.github.com/lena/pt-manifest-export (will upload final to confluence).
Chris: Ack. Role created: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/pt-assessor-role.
ops-bot: Notice: dedicated-cluster-pt reserved for June 22 23:00-02:00 UTC.
Maya: Thanks team. Final checklist before lock: key & bucket ready, role created, runbook uploaded, audit snapshots script validated, vendor NDA signed. If all ack'd I'll post final summary.
Maya: (later) All items green. Locking retest window and publishing summary to confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pt-622-summary
security-bot: Auto-note: evidence tag pt-622 attached to ticket PT-3129 and PT-3130.
